from datetime import datetime, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from parser import parse
from scheduler import next_run, _resolve
ny = ZoneInfo('America/New_York')
s130 = parse('30 1 1 11 *')
n = next_run(s130, datetime(2026,10,31,0,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc), ny)
print('first:', n, n.utcoffset())
n2 = next_run(s130, n, ny)
print('second:', n2, n2.utcoffset())
naive = n.astimezone(ny).replace(second=0, microsecond=0).replace(tzinfo=None)
print('naive:', naive)
for a in _resolve(naive, ny):
    print(a, a.utcoffset(), 'after?', a > n)"
